question: Which papers did Geoffrey Hinton author?
sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?pub ?title ?year WHERE {
  ?pub dblp:authoredBy <https://dblp.org/pid/10/3248> .
  ?pub dblp:title ?title .
  ?pub dblp:yearOfPublication ?year .
} ORDER BY DESC(?year)

Conference papers by Christos Faloutsos from 2020
sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?pub ?title ?venue WHERE {
  ?pub dblp:authoredBy <https://dblp.org/pid/f/CFaloutsos> .
  ?pub dblp:title ?title .
  ?pub dblp:yearOfPublication "2020"^^xsd:gYear .
  ?pub dblp:publishedInStream ?stream .
  ?stream dblp:streamTitle ?venue .
  ?pub a dblp:Inproceedings .
}

question: Who authored the paper titled 'Attention Is All You Need'?
What journals are available in DBLP?
Papers by Jennifer Widom at VLDB after 2018
sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?pub ?title ?year WHERE {
  ?pub dblp:authoredBy <https://dblp.org/pid/w/JenniferWidom> .
  ?pub dblp:publishedInStream <https://dblp.org/streams/conf/vldb> .
  ?pub dblp:title ?title .
  ?pub dblp:yearOfPublication ?year .
  FILTER(?year >= "2018"^^xsd:gYear)
} ORDER BY DESC(?year)
